latestVersion.changelog:
Video Intent Studio initial release:

- Guides staged text-to-video generation from user idea to final Volcengine Ark video using bundled scripts.
- Structured workflow: capture idea → suggest/rank video types → parameter tuning → prompt preview/confirmation → generation.
- Supports adjustable parameters (duration, ratio, style, motion, etc.) and keeps prompt preview updated with changes.
- Presents 3–5 ranked video type options with stable ordering and contextual reasons.
- Includes clear state tracking and allows revisions or exit at every step.
- Integrates absolute path script execution and environment-based credential handling.
- Supports multi-language interaction, defaulting to Chinese if input is in Chinese.
